title: Lean LFM-to-Dirac Derivation
description: Noncanonical Lean 4 research derivation through DIRAC-017. Starting from a positive two-field C19 action, the artifact derives a massive C19 Klein-Gordon tangent, proves that a cubical four-component Dirac Hamiltonian squares to its continuum symbol, controls lattice and centered-time corrections, and derives the positive-frequency density/current limit from the same action and embeddings. It additionally proves a scoped cube-translation copy exchange and a conditional cubical spin-one-half representation: exact conventional-spin intertwiners on both copies, explicit spectrum, positive native inner product, continuous unitary rotations with 2pi sign reversal and 4pi return, and interpreted-Hamiltonian covariance. The complete chain passes an adversarial audit and deterministic clean-checkout reproduction. Dynamical realization on a localized carrier, a physical electron, electromagnetic coupling, and uniqueness remain open.
